prompt:
Our team's shared operations notes file (`MEMORY.md`) has grown completely out of control — it's over 200 lines and nobody can find anything anymore. We need it restructured into a proper tiered system so the team knows what to load immediately at the start of each session, what's actively in progress, and what's completed history.

The file contains a mix of workflows, active real estate deals, completed transactions, contact directories, and organizational data. Please reorganize everything appropriately. Critically, we have two important system-level directives embedded in the current file (look for the HTML comment lines at the top) — these must be preserved in the new main index file.

For all the people, companies, properties, and projects mentioned throughout the notes, we also need a structured, machine-queryable entity index so we can look up anyone or anything by ID without scanning through prose. This index should live in a file called `graph.jsonl`.

The end result should leave `MEMORY.md` as a short navigation index and put everything else in the right place under a `memory/` folder.
